purpose: The math under the Value graph: the value axis, the date axis and its ticks, snapping, the coloured bands, the series paths and the label rows.
namedChanges: Comments made generic (tags of internal projects, review rounds and people removed).

the one import, `import { kindClass, type ScaleDirection, type ValueCardData, type ValueLevel } from "../../lib/base/planValueModel"`, is now `from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model"` (a value import since 0.2.0, for `kindClass`)

the block `MIN_YEAR`, `MAX_YEAR`, `YEAR_RANGE_SENTENCE`, `yearOutOfRange` (lines 184-195, with their doc comments) is replaced by `import { MAX_YEAR, MIN_YEAR, YEAR_RANGE_SENTENCE, yearOutOfRange } from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-date-rules"` and `export { MAX_YEAR, MIN_YEAR, YEAR_RANGE_SENTENCE, yearOutOfRange };`, so the export list is the source's.

The one function that changed is `markerHalf(kind, resource?)`: it takes the card's flag and reads the kind through `kindClass(kind, resource)` (Budget is the Goal point on a Resource; the kind is trimmed).

library.title: Value graph geometry (axes, date ticks, bands)
library.note: Math only; the drawn graph is value-graph.
